response.reason: The symmetric formulation exp(-|x|) with conditional numerator computes sigmoid exactly for both signs (and handles ±0 correctly giving 0.5), and the FP32 internal arithmetic with round-to-nearest division plus the explicit cvt.rn.f16.f32 rounding is accurate to ~2^-23 relative error, far below FP16 half-ulp, so final correctly-rounded FP16 outputs hold over the legal domain.
